# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

# Resolve this Rmd's directory, then locate setup_publication.R from there.
rmd_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)),
  error = function(e) normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
)

setup_candidates <- c(
  file.path(rmd_dir, "inputs", "scripts", "setup_publication.R"),
  file.path(rmd_dir, "..", "inputs", "scripts", "setup_publication.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "inputs", "scripts", "setup_publication.R")
)

setup_path <- setup_candidates[file.exists(setup_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(setup_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not locate inputs/scripts/setup_publication.R from the Rmd location or working directory.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

source(setup_path)

# Keep knitted previews at the same physical width as the exported infographic.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(out.width = paste0(PUB$infographic$width_in, "in"))


# ============================================================================
# CURRENT REPORT SOURCE WHITELIST
# ============================================================================
# The infographic may draw from BOTH:
#   1. source files used by the current figures.Rmd, and
#   2. source files used by the current tables.Rmd.
#
# This prevents old/retired source IDs from silently re-entering the report
# while preserving table-derived statistics that belong in the chapter
# "By the Numbers" pages.

CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES <- c(
  "FIG101", "FIG102", "FIG103", "FIG104", "FIG105", "FIG106",
  "FIG107", "FIG108", "FIG201", "FIG202", "FIG203", "FIG204",
  "FIG205", "FIG206", "FIG207", "FIG208", "FIG301", "FIG302",
  "FIG303", "FIG304a", "FIG304b", "FIG305", "FIG307", "FIG308",
  "FIG309", "FIG310", "FIG401", "FIG402", "FIG403", "FIG404",
  "FIG405", "FIG406", "FIG407", "FIG408", "FIG409", "FIG410",
  "FIG501", "FIG502", "FIG503", "FIG504", "FIG505", "FIG506",
  "FIG507", "FIG508", "FIG601", "FIG602", "FIG603", "FIG604a",
  "FIG604b", "FIG605a", "FIG605b", "FIG606", "FIG607", "FIG608",
  "FIG609"
)

CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES <- c(
  "TAB101", "TAB201", "TAB202", "TAB202a", "TAB202b", "TAB202c",
  "TAB202d", "TAB202e", "TAB202f", "TAB202g", "TAB202h", "TAB301",
  "TAB302", "TAB303", "TAB401", "TAB402", "TAB403", "TAB404",
  "TAB501", "TAB502", "TAB503", "TAB504", "TAB505", "TAB505a",
  "TAB505b", "TAB505c", "TAB506", "TAB601", "TAB602", "TAB603",
  "TAB603a", "TAB603b", "TAB604", "TAB605", "TAB605a", "TAB605b",
  "TAB605c"
)

CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES <- unique(c(
  CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES,
  CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES
))

read_current_source <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES) {
    stop(
      "`", id, "` is not referenced by the current figures.Rmd or tables.Rmd. ",
      "Update CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES only after the report source files change.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  read_infographic_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_figure <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current figure source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_table <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current table source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}


# ============================================================================
# GENERIC BY-THE-NUMBERS HELPERS
# ============================================================================

info_label <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))) return("—")
  as.character(x)
}

info_cell <- function(value, label, value_type, projected = FALSE) {
  if (!is.finite(value)) return("—")

  suffix <- if (projected) "P" else ""
  paste0(format_value(value, value_type), " (", info_label(label), suffix, ")")
}

metric_values <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    first_value,
    first_label,
    last_value,
    last_label,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    projected = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID   = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section  = section,
    Measure  = measure,
    Earlier  = info_cell(first_value, first_label, value_type),
    Latest   = info_cell(last_value, last_label, value_type, projected = projected),
    Change   = format_change(first_value, last_value, change_type),
    Emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_series <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    df,
    column,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    year_column = "Year",
    academic = FALSE,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    transform = identity
) {
  first <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "first",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  last <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "last",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  first$value <- transform(first$value)
  last$value  <- transform(last$value)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first$value,
    first_label = first$label,
    last_value = last$value,
    last_label = last$label,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_snapshot <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    value,
    label,
    value_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = "—",
    Latest    = info_cell(value, label, value_type),
    Change    = "—",
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

metric_text <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    earlier,
    latest,
    change = "—",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = earlier,
    Latest    = latest,
    Change    = change,
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

latest_row <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yr <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  df[which.max(yr), , drop = FALSE]
}

first_last_year_labels <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yrs <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  yrs <- yrs[is.finite(yrs)]
  c(first = as.character(min(yrs)), last = as.character(max(yrs)))
}

finalize_infographic_data <- function(data, section_order) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data$Measure), nzchar(.data$Measure)) %>%
    mutate(
      Section = factor(.data$Section, levels = section_order),
      RowOrder = row_number()
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$Section, .data$RowOrder)
}

export_current_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter_number,
    title,
    subtitle,
    name,
    source_figures,
    section_order
) {
  data <- finalize_infographic_data(data, section_order)

  build_page <- function(page_data, page_number, total_pages, is_last_page) {
    build_infographic_table(
      data = page_data,
      id = paste0(name, "_page_", page_number),
      chapter_number = chapter_number,
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      notes = if (is_last_page) {
        paste0(
          "**Source:** Derived from the current report figures and tables: ",
          paste(source_figures, collapse = ", "),
          ". See the cited figures and tables for full source information."
        )
      } else {
        character()
      }
    )
  }

  exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
    data = data,
    build_page = build_page,
    name = name
  )

  knitr::include_graphics(
    vapply(exports, `[[`, character(1), "png_path")
  )
}
```

# Current Table 1.01 source: field-level international shares in U.S. STEM training.
tab101 <- read_current_table("TAB101")


field_share_metric <- function(
    field,
    degree_prefix,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- tab101 %>%
    filter(normalize_label(.data$Field) == normalize_label(field))

  if (nrow(row) != 1) return(NULL)

  first_col <- paste0(degree_prefix, "_FirstYear")
  last_col  <- paste0(degree_prefix, "_LastYear")

  if (!all(c(first_col, last_col) %in% names(row))) return(NULL)

  # TAB101's source citation covers 1995–2024. metadata_year_range() now
  # reads both endpoints from that citation rather than only the first year.
  source_range <- metadata_year_range(infographic_meta_id(tab101))

  first_year_candidates <- c(
    paste0(degree_prefix, "_FirstYear_Year"),
    paste0(degree_prefix, "_FirstYearYear"),
    "FirstYear"
  )

  last_year_candidates <- c(
    paste0(degree_prefix, "_LastYear_Year"),
    paste0(degree_prefix, "_LastYearYear"),
    "LastYear"
  )

  first_year_col <- intersect(first_year_candidates, names(row))
  last_year_col  <- intersect(last_year_candidates, names(row))

  first_year <- if (length(first_year_col)) {
    year_number(row[[first_year_col[[1]]]])[[1]]
  } else {
    unname(source_range[["first"]])
  }

  last_year <- if (length(last_year_col)) {
    year_number(row[[last_year_col[[1]]]])[[1]]
  } else {
    unname(source_range[["last"]])
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "field_dependence",
    section = "International dependence in selected STEM fields",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(row[[first_col]])[[1]],
    first_label = calendar_year_label(first_year),
    last_value = numeric_clean(row[[last_col]])[[1]],
    last_label = calendar_year_label(last_year),
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# STEM total derived from the same three series plotted in FIG103.
stem_cols <- intersect(c("Bachelors", "Masters", "Doctorate"), names(fig103))

fig103_total <- fig103 %>%
  mutate(
    Total_STEM = rowSums(
      across(all_of(stem_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))),
      na.rm = FALSE
    )
  )


projection_metric <- function(df, country, measure, stat_id, value_type = "count") {
  country_df <- df %>%
    filter(.data$Country == country, is.finite(.data$value))

  observed <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Observed") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  projected <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Projected") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  if (nrow(observed) != 1 || nrow(projected) != 1) return(NULL)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "projection",
    section = "Where the pipeline is heading",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = observed$value[[1]],
    first_label = observed$Year[[1]],
    last_value = projected$value[[1]],
    last_label = projected$Year[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = country %in% c("United States", "China", "India"),
    projected = TRUE
  )
}

# Current Table 2.01 source: regional origin of international students.
tab201 <- read_current_table("TAB201")


regional_share_metric <- function(
    region_column,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  region_columns <- setdiff(names(tab201), c("Year", "Percent Asia"))

  endpoint <- function(which = c("first", "last")) {
    which <- match.arg(which)

    year <- common_endpoint_year(
      tab201,
      columns = c(region_column, region_columns),
      which = which
    )

    total <- row_sum_data(tab201, region_columns) %>%
      filter(.data$Year == .env$year) %>%
      pull(.data$Value)

    value <- tab201 %>%
      filter(year_number(.data$Year) == .env$year) %>%
      pull(all_of(region_column)) %>%
      numeric_clean()

    if (
      length(total) != 1 ||
      length(value) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(total[[1]]) ||
      !is.finite(value[[1]])
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    list(
      value = value[[1]] / total[[1]],
      label = academic_period_label(tab201, year)
    )
  }

  first <- endpoint("first")
  last  <- endpoint("last")

  if (is.null(first) || is.null(last)) return(NULL)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "regional",
    section = "Regional concentration",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first$value,
    first_label = first$label,
    last_value = last$value,
    last_label = last$label,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


country_share_metric <- function(df, country, level, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (!country %in% names(df)) return(NULL)

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "origin", "Where international students come from",
    paste0(country, " share of international ", level),
    df, country, "share", "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

field_count_metric <- function(field, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (!field %in% names(fig203)) return(NULL)

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "field", "Where international students concentrate",
    paste0("International students in ", field),
    fig203, field, "count", "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

stem_country_metric <- function(country, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (!country %in% names(fig204)) return(NULL)

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "field", "Where international students concentrate",
    paste0("International STEM students from ", country),
    fig204, country, "count", "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

change_snapshot <- function(category, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  row <- fig206 %>%
    filter(normalize_label(.data$Category) == normalize_label(category))

  if (nrow(row) != 1) return(NULL)

  metric_snapshot(
    stat_id, "current", "Current enrollment pressures",
    paste0(category, " enrollment change"),
    numeric_clean(row$Change)[[1]],
    source_latest_year(fig206),
    "percent_value",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

reason_metric <- function(reason, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  row <- fig208 %>%
    filter(normalize_label(.data$Reason) == normalize_label(reason))

  if (nrow(row) != 1) return(NULL)

  periods <- temporal_columns(row, exclude = "Reason")
  values <- numeric_clean(unlist(row[periods$column], use.names = FALSE))
  keep <- is.finite(values)

  periods <- periods[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  values <- values[keep]

  if (length(values) < 2) return(NULL)

  metric_values(
    stat_id, "recruitment", "Recruitment and barriers",
    paste0("Institutions citing ", tolower(reason)),
    values[[1]], periods$column[[1]],
    values[[length(values)]], periods$column[[nrow(periods)]],
    "percent_value", "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

degree_conversion_metric <- function(df, population, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  degree_col <- intersect(
    c("doctorates", "doctors", "Doctorates", "Doctorate"),
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(degree_col) == 0) return(NULL)

  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.numeric(.data$Year),
      value = numeric_clean(.data[[degree_col[[1]]]]) * 100
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "workforce", "From degree to workforce",
    paste0(population, " doctorate holders working in STEM"),
    df2, "value", "percent_value", "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# Top-10 employer concentration derived from FIG305 exactly as Figure 3.05/3.06
# derives firm shares from the annual Grand Total row.
h1b_top10 <- function(raw) {
  names(raw) <- trimws(names(raw))

  total_row <- raw %>%
    filter(trimws(.data$Company) == "Grand Total")

  year_cols <- setdiff(names(raw), c("Company", "Grand Total"))
  year_cols <- year_cols[grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", year_cols)]
  year_cols <- year_cols[as.integer(year_cols) <= 2025]

  totals <- total_row %>%
    select(all_of(year_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Year", values_to = "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
      Total = numeric_clean(.data$Total)
    )

  raw %>%
    filter(trimws(.data$Company) != "Grand Total") %>%
    select(.data$Company, all_of(year_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-.data$Company, names_to = "Year", values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
      Count = replace_na(numeric_clean(.data$Count), 0)
    ) %>%
    left_join(totals, by = "Year") %>%
    group_by(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_max(.data$Count, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      Share = sum(.data$Count, na.rm = TRUE) / first(.data$Total) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

bookend_category_metric <- function(
    df,
    id_col,
    category,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c(id_col, category) %in% names(df))) return(NULL)

  rows <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[id_col]]))

  if (nrow(rows) < 2) return(NULL)

  first <- rows %>% slice_head(n = 1)
  last  <- rows %>% slice_tail(n = 1)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(first[[category]])[[1]],
    first_label = as.character(first[[id_col]])[[1]],
    last_value = numeric_clean(last[[category]])[[1]],
    last_label = as.character(last[[id_col]])[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

  mutate(
    K12 = parse_number(as.character(.data$`K-12 (in USD)`)),
    Tertiary = parse_number(as.character(.data$`Tertiary (in USD)`)),
    Ratio = .data$Tertiary / .data$K12
  )


# Field retention: compare the same two cohorts used in Figure 4.07.
# IMPORTANT: use .env$field inside filter(). Without .env, dplyr can resolve
# `field` as the data column rather than the function argument, which makes
# every row pass the filter and repeats one field's values across all metrics.
fig407_long <- fig407 %>%
  mutate(across(-field, as.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-field, names_to = "cohort", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = recode(
      cohort,
      entry_2003 = "2003/04 cohort",
      entry_2011 = "2011/12 cohort"
    ),
    cohort = factor(
      cohort,
      levels = c("2003/04 cohort", "2011/12 cohort")
    )
  )

retention_metric <- function(field, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  row <- fig407_long %>%
    filter(
      .data$field == .env$field,
      is.finite(.data$pct)
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$cohort)

  if (nrow(row) < 2) return(NULL)

  first <- row %>% slice_head(n = 1)
  last  <- row %>% slice_tail(n = 1)

  metric_values(
    stat_id, "persistence", "Keeping STEM students in STEM",
    paste0(field, ": graduates remaining in entry field"),
    first$pct[[1]], as.character(first$cohort[[1]]),
    last$pct[[1]],  as.character(last$cohort[[1]]),
    "percent_value", "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

}


# FIG409 is country-by-year, with country names in the first column.
mobility <- fig409 %>%
  rename(Country = 1) %>%
  select(-any_of("Grand Total")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Country, names_to = "Year", values_to = "Share") %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
    Share = parse_number(as.character(.data$Share))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Share))

mobility_snapshot <- function(country, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  row <- mobility %>%
    filter(.data$Country == country) %>%
    slice_max(.data$Year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

  if (nrow(row) != 1) return(NULL)

  metric_snapshot(
    stat_id, "mobility", "International mobility",
    paste0("Tertiary students studying abroad — ", country),
    row$Share[[1]], row$Year[[1]], "percent_value",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# FIG410 is a time series of net student flows by country.
fig410 <- fig410 %>% mutate(across(-Year, as.numeric))

flow_metric <- function(country, display_country = country, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (!country %in% names(fig410)) return(NULL)

  tmp <- fig410 %>%
    transmute(
      Year = as.numeric(.data$Year),
      Flow_millions = numeric_clean(.data[[country]]) / 1e6
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "mobility", "International mobility",
    paste0("Net international-student flow — ", display_country, " (millions)"),
    tmp, "Flow_millions", "rate", "points",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# Conference summary used by current Table 5.01.
conference_common <- tab501 %>%
  filter(.data$country %in% c("United States", "China")) %>%
  group_by(.data$conf_norm, .data$conference, .data$year, .data$country) %>%
  summarise(share = sum(.data$share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = .data$country, values_from = .data$share) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[["United States"]]), !is.na(.data$China)) %>%
  arrange(.data$conf_norm, .data$year)

conference_windows <- conference_common %>%
  group_by(.data$conf_norm) %>%
  arrange(.data$year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    USFirst = first(.data[["United States"]]),
    USLatest = last(.data[["United States"]]),
    ChinaFirst = first(.data$China),
    ChinaLatest = last(.data$China),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_conferences <- nrow(conference_windows)

conference_metric <- function(country, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (n_conferences == 0) return(NULL)

  first_value <- if (country == "United States") {
    median(conference_windows$USFirst, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    median(conference_windows$ChinaFirst, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  last_value <- if (country == "United States") {
    median(conference_windows$USLatest, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    median(conference_windows$ChinaLatest, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id, "conference", "AI conference leadership",
    paste0("Median ", if_else(country == "United States", "US", "China"),
           " share across ", n_conferences, " AI conferences"),
    first_value, "first obs.",
    last_value, "latest obs.",
    "share", "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


patent_gap_metric <- function(df, technology, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  if (!"Year" %in% names(df)) names(df)[1] <- "Year"

  needed <- c("Year", "United States of America", "China")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(df))) return(NULL)

  tmp <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Year = numeric_clean(.data$Year),
      Gap = numeric_clean(.data[["United States of America"]]) -
        numeric_clean(.data$China)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Gap))

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "patents", "Patent leadership is shifting",
    paste0("US–China patent-grant gap: ", technology),
    tmp, "Gap", "signed_count", "count_delta",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


company_patent_metric <- function(company, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  row <- tab506 %>%
    filter(normalize_label(.data$Company) == normalize_label(company))

  if (nrow(row) != 1) return(NULL)

  periods <- temporal_columns(
    row,
    exclude = c("Company", "Country")
  )

  values <- numeric_clean(
    unlist(row[periods$column], use.names = FALSE)
  )

  keep <- is.finite(values)
  periods <- periods[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  values <- values[keep]

  if (length(values) < 2) return(NULL)

  metric_values(
    stat_id, "patents", "Patent leadership is shifting",
    paste0(company, " US patent grants"),
    values[[1]], periods$year[[1]],
    values[[length(values)]], periods$year[[nrow(periods)]],
    "count", "count_delta",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

  }

  if (length(col) == 0) return(NULL)

    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "investment", "R&D investment",

    tmp, "value", "currency_billions", "percent",

}

perm_expiry_metric <- function(country, stat_id, emphasis = FALSE) {
  series <- tab604 %>%
    filter(normalize_label(.data$Country) == normalize_label(country)) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = numeric_clean(.data$Year),
      Count = numeric_clean(.data$Count)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Count)) %>%
    group_by(.data$Year) %>%
    summarise(
      expired = sum(
        .data$Count[
          normalize_label(.data$Status) == normalize_label("Certified-Expired")
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      used = sum(
        .data$Count[
          normalize_label(.data$Status) == normalize_label("Certified")
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Share = .data$expired / (.data$expired + .data$used)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data$Share))

  if (nrow(series) < 2) return(NULL)

  metric_series(
    stat_id, "perm", "Unused PERM certifications",
    paste0(country, ": share of PERM certifications expiring unused"),
    series, "Share", "share", "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


wait_time_series <- function(df, category) {
  text_col <- paste0(category, ".1")

  if (!all(c("Year", text_col) %in% names(df))) return(NULL)

  to_months <- function(txt) {
    txt <- as.character(txt)

    years <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(str_match(txt, "(\\d+)\\s*years?")[, 2])
    )
    months <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(str_match(txt, "(\\d+)\\s*months?")[, 2])
    )

    years[is.na(years)] <- 0
    months[is.na(months)] <- 0

    out <- years * 12 + months
    out[!nzchar(trimws(txt))] <- NA_real_
    out
  }

  df %>%
    transmute(
      Year = numeric_clean(.data$Year),
      Months = to_months(.data[[text_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Months))
}


wait_time_metric <- function(
    df,
    geography,
    category,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tmp <- wait_time_series(df, category)
  if (is.null(tmp) || nrow(tmp) < 2) return(NULL)

  first <- data_endpoint(tmp, "Months", "first")
  last  <- data_endpoint(tmp, "Months", "last")

  duration <- function(months) {
    rounded <- round(months)
    years <- rounded %/% 12
    rem <- rounded %% 12
    paste0(years, "Y ", rem, "M")
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id, "wait", "Employment-based green-card wait times",
    paste0(geography, " ", category, " wait"),
    paste0(duration(first$value), " (", first$label, ")"),
    paste0(duration(last$value), " (", last$label, ")"),
    paste0(
      if (last$value - first$value > 0) "+" else if (last$value - first$value < 0) "-" else "",
      duration(abs(last$value - first$value))
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# Use the same shared denial parser used by figures.Rmd when available.
denial_series <- function(df, label) {
  # Current FIG605 a/b files contain new/renewal denial fields. Prefer a direct
  # "New Denials" column when present; otherwise reconstruct from the common
  # figure-source columns.
  if ("New Denials" %in% names(df)) {
    return(
      df %>%
        transmute(
          Year = as.numeric(.data$Year),
          Count = numeric_clean(.data$`New Denials`)
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Count))
    )
  }

  denial_col <- intersect(
    c("New Denied", "New Denials", "Initial Denied", "Denied"),
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(denial_col) == 0) return(NULL)

  df %>%
    transmute(
      Year = as.numeric(.data$Year),
      Count = numeric_clean(.data[[denial_col[[1]]]])
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data$Year), is.finite(.data$Count))
}
